**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/03 (Fri) 09:32
- [USER] User inquired about who a digital product designer is.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A digital product designer is responsible for designing and creating digital products such as websites, mobile apps, software, and other digital interfaces.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The main goal of a digital product designer is to create an intuitive and user-friendly digital product that meets the needs of the target audience while also meeting business goals and objectives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital product designers typically work in a cross-functional team that includes product managers, developers, and other stakeholders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital product designers are involved in the entire product development process, from researching user needs to designing user interfaces, to testing and refining the product.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The role of a digital product designer requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) design, user interface (UI) design, visual design, and human-computer interaction.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital product designers should have a good understanding of the latest design trends, technologies, and tools used in the industry.
- [USER] User requested a comprehensive beginners curriculum for learning digital product design, assuming no previous design and research experience.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A comprehensive beginners curriculum for learning digital product design was created, divided into different modules:
  - Module 1: Introduction to Digital Product Design
  - Module 2: User Research
  - Module 3: User Experience Design (UX)
  - Module 4: User Interface Design (UI)
  - Module 5: Interaction Design
  - Module 6: Design Tools and Software
  - Module 7: Designing for Business
  - Module 8: Professional Development
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The curriculum aims to get a novice to intermediate knowledge and experience in digital product design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] By completing the curriculum, a novice should have a strong understanding of the digital product design process and be able to create user-friendly, visually appealing digital products that meet business goals.
- [USER] User requested an expansion on Module 4, including practical exercise examples.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Practical exercises for Module 4: User Interface Design (UI) were provided:
  - Design a landing page
  - Create a UI kit
  - Redesign an existing product or app
  - Design a mobile app
  - Create a design system
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Each exercise includes specific tasks such as choosing a product, determining layout, and conducting usability testing.
- [USER] User requested an expansion on Module 3, including practical exercises examples or activities.
